conf.comment: pki-ocsp / ocsp-responder / windows-event. Parsing is deliberately NOT implemented here: the Elastic integration is the parser downstream (System integration (winlog input, Security and Application channels)). Re-implementing that parsing in Cribl would fight it and yield duplicate or conflicting fields, so this pipeline only identifies the event and tags event.dataset, then passes _raw through unmodified. Direct route (no cross-domain guard hop).
